Why does the US East Coast get more SLR than average?
Forebulge collapse (GIA) + AMOC weakening (dynamic oceanography) + land subsidence
Gravity + GIA pattern unique to each melting glacier; predicts regional RSL response
What was sea level at LGM?
Marine ice sheet instability (MISI) on retrograde slope could trigger runaway collapse of WAIS
What is a compound flood event?
Simultaneous tide + surge + wave + river flood; probability >> any single component
